title: Server features
drawioHelp: Use the default Draw.io editor or enter your own editor address. Existing diagrams are preserved.
pdfHelp: Leave empty to use the built-in PDF exporter. When configured, exported PDFs are sent to this server for PDF/A-2b conversion. Save before testing the connection.
iframeHelp: Choose which sites may display this app inside a frame. Document access still requires login. OAuth consent screens always block frames.
iframeAllowed: Allow the sites below to display Nopetion
originsHelp: One http:// or https:// origin per line, without paths or wildcards. At least one is required when enabled.
saved: Saved. New editor sessions and requests use these settings.
saveFailed: Could not save. Check the addresses and allowed sites, or reload if another tab changed the settings.
connectionFailed: Could not connect to the saved Gotenberg server.
